title: Common OTLP settings reach the signal-specific exporters
summary: Decodes three independently emitted protobuf signals after HTTP delivery and compares request paths, compression and all suite header values.

subject.symbol: Original OTLP logging, tracing and metrics exporters → HTTP collector

change.description: Boot introduces `management.opentelemetry.otlp` defaults for the collector endpoint, compression and headers across logs, traces and metrics. A signal-specific setting can override the corresponding common value.
